map.μₓ = −ln(0.99) ≈ 0.01005。即该岁连续死亡力约 1.0%。: μₓ = −ln(0.99) ≈ 0.01005. That is, the continuous force of mortality at that age is about 1.0%.
map.死亡力和死亡率 q 关系？: Relation between force of mortality and q?
map.qₓ = 1−pₓ = 1−e^−μ ≈ μ（μ 小的时候近似相等）；精确用 q: qₓ = 1−pₓ = 1−e^−μ ≈ μ (approximately equal when μ is small); exactly q = 1−e^−μ.
map.死亡力为负有意义吗？: Is a negative force of mortality meaningful?
map.无意义。死亡力 mu 由负对数 p 得出，p（年生存概率）在0到1之间，故 mu: No. The force μ comes from the negative log of p; since p (yearly survival) is between 0 and 1, μ is never negative. A negative result means the input p exceeds 1 — check the data.
